subject: Unable to upload app or delete an old app - is shinyapps.io having problems?

messages.author: 0281a93af523952a
messages.subject: Unable to upload app or delete an old app - is shinyapps.io having problems?
parts:
Hi,

I am having trouble using the shinyapps.io server this morning. 

When trying to delete an existing app using the shiny dashboard, I get:

Waiting for task: 350053361
  purge-bundles: Deleting bundles
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 350053374 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Timeout

I get a similar problem upload a new version of an already existing app:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 141523...
Error: HTTP 500
POST https://api.shinyapps.io/v1/applications/141523/upload
Internal Server Error

I don't believe the problem relates to my app in particular, as it works fine locally, and has been uploaded many times in the past,
Any advice on how to proceed? 

cheers,
Bruce
